provenance.semantics: Gallery authored candidate heuristics; not Danbooru wiki assertions or corpus-derived probabilities.

facets.label: Hair length
facets.rationale: Primary lengths compete only for the same hair region; longer subtypes are not mutually exclusive with long hair.

facets.label: Hair colour
facets.rationale: Multiple colours can describe dyed sections, gradients or different subjects. Colour is not globally exclusive.

facets.label: Upper garments
facets.rationale: Multiple upper garments are commonly layered. Garment identity must precede any local restriction.

facets.label: Lower garments
facets.rationale: Skirts over trousers or shorts are valid; ask for layer order rather than prohibit the pair.

facets.label: Dresses and one-piece garments
facets.rationale: An outer dress or robe may coexist with inner garments.

facets.label: Ensembles
facets.rationale: Ensembles have parts and can be remixed; membership does not occupy a single exclusive slot.

facets.label: Outer layers
facets.rationale: Different values may need separate instances, regions or views; scope must be established before enforcement.

facets.label: Legwear
facets.rationale: Different layers and legs can have different legwear; socks over tights are allowed.

facets.label: Footwear
facets.rationale: Barefoot may refer to one foot or a removed shoe. No unscoped footwear exclusion.

facets.label: Headwear
facets.rationale: Headwear, ornaments and hoods can layer or be carried.

facets.label: Handwear
facets.rationale: Handwear can differ between hands or be partly removed.

facets.label: Clothing material
facets.rationale: Mixed materials and trim are compatible; material values are not global alternatives.

facets.label: Clothing patterns
facets.rationale: Patterns can coexist on panels or layers; no global pattern exclusion.

facets.label: Sleeve length
facets.rationale: Only the same sleeve of the same garment competes. An inner long sleeve and outer sleeveless garment are valid.

facets.label: Skirt length
facets.rationale: Different skirts and asymmetrical hems are exceptions; ordinary skirt is a compatible superclass.

facets.label: Clothing fit
facets.rationale: Fit is local to a garment and body region; tight inner and loose outer layers can coexist.

facets.label: Garment fastening
facets.rationale: Different fasteners and partial opening require local context.

facets.label: Clothing condition
facets.rationale: Condition and removal describe states or actions, not a prohibition on garment tags.

facets.label: Accessories
facets.rationale: Different values may need separate instances, regions or views; scope must be established before enforcement.

facets.label: Female character count
facets.rationale: Exact counts compete within the same scene; counts of different categories are independent.

facets.label: Male character count
facets.rationale: Exact counts compete within the same scene; counts of different categories are independent.

facets.label: Other character count
facets.rationale: Exact counts compete within the same scene; counts of different categories are independent.

facets.label: Subject count composition
facets.rationale: Solo and group require subject interpretation; projected images and background people can qualify the count.

facets.label: Open-ended counts
facets.rationale: Different values may need separate instances, regions or views; scope must be established before enforcement.

facets.label: Framing
facets.rationale: Framing differs by subject and panel; detailed insets do not contradict a full-body view.

facets.label: Subject view
facets.rationale: Only the same depicted surface in the same view competes; reflection and turned heads require context.

facets.label: Camera elevation
facets.rationale: Above and below can describe different cameras, panels or subjects.

facets.label: Camera treatment
facets.rationale: Lens, angle, crop and focus are independent facets, not exclusive styles.

facets.label: Image layout
facets.rationale: Different values may need separate instances, regions or views; scope must be established before enforcement.

facets.label: Subject focus
facets.rationale: A focus is not a ban on all other subjects or regions.

facets.label: Scene enclosure
facets.rationale: A scene can cross a threshold or show outdoors through a window. Do not impose image-wide exclusion.

facets.label: Scene locations
facets.rationale: Locations nest and combine; a beach and ocean are compatible.

facets.label: Time of day
facets.rationale: Time labels may span transitions, separate panels or hemispheres; warn only for one scene instant.

facets.label: Season
facets.rationale: Seasons are local to one place and time; mixed seasonal motifs are not necessarily a contradiction.

facets.label: Weather
facets.rationale: Sun showers, mixed precipitation and local weather coexist; no pairwise weather prohibition.

facets.label: Background treatment
facets.rationale: Background treatments can differ across panels and regions; white and transparent are not universally exclusive tags.

facets.label: Light sources
facets.rationale: Multiple light sources are normal and should not be mutually exclusive.

facets.label: Light direction
facets.rationale: Fill lights, rim lights and key lights can coexist.

facets.label: Light quality
facets.rationale: Different sources and regions have different light qualities.

facets.label: Art medium
facets.rationale: Mixed media, overpainting and stylised rendering are deliberate artistic choices.

facets.label: Palette
facets.rationale: Spot colour and regional colouring invalidate a global monochrome-versus-colour exclusion.

facets.label: Art technique
facets.rationale: Different values may need separate instances, regions or views; scope must be established before enforcement.

facets.label: Text and symbols
facets.rationale: Text may exist on one panel while another is text-free; languages and signatures can coexist.

facets.label: Objects
facets.rationale: Object types coexist; recognition is not a requirement to list every object.
